messages:
maria: Heads-up — rolling out the staged feature-toggle for embeddings routing during the EU quiet window in ~4h. Checklist below, please ack and call any blockers.

maria: Checklist: 1) Pin v2.3.7 for EU model alias, 2) Canary 5% -> 20% over 30m, 3) Monitor latency/error spikes, 4) Rollback playbook ready, 5) Release notes published.

kevin: ack. pin command?

maria: use the deploybot pin API: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/pin -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"alias":"eu-embed", "version":"v2.3.7"}'
```

deploy-bot: Pin request received for alias=eu-embed -> version=v2.3.7 by maria. Pin applied to dedicated routing groups.

simon: Are we doing a canary kill switch if errors > 2% for 3 consecutive mins? who flips it?

maria: yes — auto kill at 2% errors will trigger. Manual rollback owner = simon. Steps: 1) run `curl` to set alias back to v2.3.6, 2) cancel canary ramp in Deploy UI, 3) open incident channel #incidents if rollback occurs.

alexa: Release notes live: https://confluence.redwood/release/emb-routes-2026-03-21 — includes customer-impact section and known issues.

neil: Dashboards: eng-ops/slo-embed and per-region latency are primed. Alert thresholds: p95 > 600ms or error% > 1.5% will page oncall. I set a short-lived synthetic every 15s for EU canary to catch regressions.

ops-bot: Canary ramp scheduled: 05:00 UTC start (EU quiet window). Ramp plan: 5% -> 20% over 30m -> 50% after stable 1h.

kevin: one question on observability: do we have token-cost smoke checks enabled? want to ensure embeddings cost per-req didn't regress with new vector dims.

maria: yes, cost probe enabled. If cost/unit increases >6% we abort ramp. Simon will run manual metric check at +45m.

simon: noted. I'll be standing by for manual rollback if error spike. If I flip rollback, i'll post `rollback by simon` here and run the alias revert command.

deploy-bot: Canary at 5% started. No anomalies in first 3m. Metrics: error% 0.2, p95 420ms, cost delta +1.1%.

maria: thanks. please keep updates short: %/p95/cost. If anyone sees anything odd, call the rollback lane immediately. :thumbsup:

kevin: ack. attending the quiet window watch from my side.

alexa: added release note email to partners list (sent).

neil: monitoring green. will escalate if thresholds tripped.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 20% complete. Current: error% 0.3, p95 440ms, cost delta +1.7%. No auto-kill.

maria: final check — all owners acked? If yes, proceed with 50% after stable hour.

kevin: ack.

simon: ack. ready to rollback if needed.

alexa: acked. docs/notes published.

neil: ack on monitoring.

maria: thanks team — marking this thread as the launch watch log. I'll post rollback record if we ever flip it.

deploy-bot: Canary stable at 1h. Proceeding to 50% per plan.
